verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a workflow builder ("Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials..."), but nothing in the evidence shows these workflows can run on a recurring schedule (cron, intervals, or timed recurrence). The documented automations appear event-driven: webhooks fire on activity, and users are notified when requests ship. A workflow feature without a recurring schedule is an adjacent capability, not this story, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Build workflows for SLAs, automatically extending trials, offering discounts, and much more.
